### Content

The 2026-08-24 editorial-calendar question was due: where readers can find Progression Fantasy and LitRPG recommendations. Pull request #114 published `2026 Progression Fantasy 与 LitRPG 推荐怎么找？从标签、社区到完结状态的选择方法`, a research-heavy reader guide with more than 10,000 Chinese main-text characters, 22 academic references, 24 platform/community/first-party references, current Royal Road and community evidence, counterexamples/boundaries, and an original four-factor recommendation-confidence synthesis. Its reusable method combines a six-dimensional demand vector with a four-layer evidence chain.

### Sources

The daily source program screened five previously untracked candidate families: Wraithmarked Creative, Shadow Alley Press, Timeless Wind Publishing, Royal Guard Publishing, and The Legion Publishers. Wraithmarked Creative, Shadow Alley Press, and Timeless Wind Publishing received complete first-party admission review and shipped through pull request #113 as conservative link-only additions to `Progression & LitRPG Publisher Discovery Starter`. Royal Guard Publishing and The Legion Publishers remain deferred because the audited first-party surfaces are primarily submission/publisher-oriented and did not provide a comparably stable reader catalog surface.

The admitted capability remains static link-only. WebNR copies no origin catalog metadata, covers, prices, reviews, accounts, retailer state, or book text and performs no origin API/HTML/feed/search polling. Rotating health review rechecked the existing Aethon Books, Mountaindale Press, and Portal Books routes; all three remained publicly reachable. The daily target of screening at least five candidates, fully auditing at least three, and shipping at least one passing integration was satisfied.

### Search and discovery

No search-ranking or traffic change was inferred from unavailable provider exports. The content decision instead followed the repository editorial calendar and current public reader-question evidence. The new guide turns platform tags, completion state, format constraints, community explanations, specialist catalogs, and first-party publishing pages into a reproducible discovery workflow. No index coverage was removed or narrowed.

### Community

Recent bounded public sampling from `r/ProgressionFantasy` and `r/litrpg` was used only as anecdotal research input: current requests expose prior reads, likes/dislikes, mechanism density, platform/format, completion status, progression path, narrative texture, and other personal constraints. Community evidence was not treated as representative population statistics. No automated community account, unsolicited promotion, or external posting action was performed.
